d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.

The Assistant Learning & Development Manager supports the implementation of the hotel's learning and development strategy by coordinating, delivering, and evaluating training programs that enhance employee performance, service excellence, and career development. The role plays a key part in building a culture of continuous learning while ensuring compliance with Minor Hotels and Tivoli brand standards.
Assist in the implementation of the annual Learning & Development strategy and training calendar.
Coordinate all mandatory and operational training programs.
Deliver induction and orientation programs for all new team members.
Facilitate brand culture, service excellence, and guest experience training.
Support departmental trainers in planning and delivering monthly training sessions.
Assist in developing leadership and supervisory development programs.
Promote a culture of continuous learning throughout the hotel.
Maintain accurate employee training records and training matrices.
Manage the Learning Management System (LMS) and ensure completion of all online learning modules.
Prepare weekly and monthly training reports and KPI dashboards.
Monitor training attendance and certification validity.
Ensure all mandatory compliance training is completed within required timelines.
Support the preparation and execution of Individual Development Plans (IDPs).
Assist department heads in identifying training needs through Training Needs Analysis (TNA).
Participate in succession planning and talent development initiatives.
Coach supervisors and departmental trainers on effective learning techniques.
Ensure compliance with Minor Hotels policies and local legislation.
Support quality assurance and brand audits by maintaining complete training documentation.
Support employee engagement activities and recognition programs.
Organize learning campaigns, workshops, and awareness events.
Promote Minor Hotels' culture, values, and service philosophy.
Participate in CSR, wellness, and colleague appreciation initiatives.
Work closely with department heads to identify operational training priorities.
Liaise with external training providers when required.
Support the Learning & Development Manager in preparing presentations and training materials.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Hospitality Management, Education, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Learning & Development, preferably in a luxury hotel.
Previous experience with Minor Hotels or an international hospitality brand is an advantage.
Excellent English communication skills; Arabic is an added advantage.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
Monthly Training Reports Submitted on Time
The Assistant Learning & Development Manager Is Authorized To
Conduct classroom and on-the-job training as assigned.
The Assistant Learning & Development Manager Is Expected To
Demonstrate Tivoli and Minor Hotels values in all interactions.
Lead by example and inspire a learning culture.
Deliver memorable learning experiences that contribute to exceptional guest satisfaction.

d: Sentinel are recruiting for an experienced Project Manager for a government digital programme in Doha. The programme brings services from many government and private-sector organisations into one citizen-facing mobile app, used by people across Qatar. The first release is in progress, with more services to follow.
The programme is growing fast and its project management office is still being set up. We want to hear from strong delivery project managers, and from senior candidates who have built or led a PMO.
q: At least 5 years in project management, including 3+ years delivering software or digital projects with agile teams
Experience working with many stakeholders, including non-technical ones
Strong planning, risk and dependency management
Jira and Confluence, or similar tools
A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field
10+ years’ experience, including leading several agile teams at once
Setting up or leading a PMO in a large programme, ideally in government, banking, telecoms or another regulated sector
Programme or change management experience (e.g. PgMP, MSP, Prosci)
PMP, PRINCE2, or a Scrum certification
Experience with mobile apps or digital services
Some extended or weekend hours may be needed in the weeks before go-live
r: Manage software projects from start to delivery, working with development teams, Scrum Masters, Product Owners and suppliers
Plan scope, milestones and dates, and keep plans current
Track dependencies, risks and issues, and escalate what needs a decision
Control scope changes and report progress to stakeholders, including senior government audiences
Check readiness before go-live and hand over to operations and support
For senior candidates: help design the programme’s methods, processes, tools and reporting, and coach teams to use them
